parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

*   **true**: performs only a dry run.
*   **false** (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request.

parameters.name: EcrOwnerAliUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the ECR from which you want to revoke permissions.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

*   **VBR**
*   **VPC**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter revoke-instance-from-express-connect-router --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --ecr-owner-ali-uid 1210123456120000 --instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --instance-type VBR --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --dry-run true --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --region cn-hangzhou
